basis: user selected Gmail for independently implemented purchase-order email
ui: explicit final review checkbox and send button
own-user result history and changed-document state

provider.setup: hidden manual input; SMTP verify without message sending

security: same Origin and CSRF on POST
CAS durable idempotency reservation before SMTP
no automatic resend for uncertain results

resultSemantics.accepted: Gmail SMTP accepted; not proof of recipient delivery or reading
resultSemantics.unknown: outcome uncertain; check Gmail before any new send
resultSemantics.sending: durably reserved; duplicate request never initiates another SMTP call

notEstablished: actual Gmail authentication until user enters credentials
